title: Keras Project Solutions - Dealing with Missing Data

cues.en: (calm music)
cues.zh: （平靜音樂）

cues.en: Instructor: Welcome everyone to our first lecture and the solutions for these project exercise questions.
cues.zh: 講師：歡迎來到專案練習解答的第一堂課。

cues.en: We'll begin with the exploratory data analysis section.
cues.zh: 先從探索式資料分析開始。

cues.en: Let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Okay, here I am at the exercise notebook.
cues.zh: 我現在在練習筆記本。

cues.en: I'm gonna start off by running the first couple of starter code cells.
cues.zh: 先執行前幾個起始程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: So that's importing the data that allows us to run our feature information function as well as loading in the actual dataset that we'll be working with.
cues.zh: 也就是匯入特徵資訊函數所需的資料，以及載入實際要使用的資料集。

cues.en: So it looks like that's all loaded up.
cues.zh: 看起來都載入好了。

cues.en: Next, let's begin exploratory data analysis.
cues.zh: 接著開始探索式資料分析。

cues.en: So as I mentioned before, it's always a good idea, especially of classification problems, to do a count plot to explore the actual balancing of your labels.
cues.zh: 如先前所說，尤其是分類問題，最好先畫計數圖，探索標籤的平衡程度。

cues.en: So we'll say sns count plot, and we'll say loan status,
cues.zh: 使用 sns.countplot，傳入 loan_status，

cues.en: and say data is equal to df.
cues.zh: 並設定 data=df。

cues.en: So that's how you can create a count plot here.
cues.zh: 這樣就能建立計數圖。

cues.en: And I would say this is an unbalanced or imbalanced problem.
cues.zh: 我會說這是個不平衡的問題。

cues.en: Notice that we have a lot more entries of people that fully pay off their loans than we have people that did not pay back.
cues.zh: 注意，全額清償貸款的筆數，遠多於沒有還款的筆數。

cues.en: And this is really common for things like classification problems that have to do with fraud or spam.
cues.zh: 這在詐欺或垃圾郵件相關的分類問題中很常見。

cues.en: There's a lot less instances of fraud or spam than there are of legitimate actions such as a legitimate email or a legitimate credit card purchase
cues.zh: 詐欺或垃圾郵件的案例，遠少於正常行為，例如正常電子郵件、合法信用卡消費，

cues.en: or a legitimate loan where it was fully paid off.
cues.zh: 或全額清償的正常貸款。

cues.en: So that's something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 所以這點要記住。

cues.en: And what that means is, we can expect to probably do very well in terms of accuracy but our precision and recall are going to be the true metrics that we'll have to evaluate our model based off of.
cues.zh: 這表示準確率可能很高，但真正要用來評估模型的是精確率和召回率。

cues.en: And we shouldn't expect to perform that well on those particular metrics due to the fact that we have a very imbalanced dataset here.
cues.zh: 因為資料非常不平衡，不應預期這些指標都會表現很好。

cues.en: So next, we want to create a histogram of the loan amount column.
cues.zh: 接著建立 loan_amnt 欄的直方圖。

cues.en: Lots of different ways we can do this.
cues.zh: 有很多不同做法。

cues.en: Probably the easiest way is to simply call a distribution plot on that column.
cues.zh: 最簡單的大概是對那一欄呼叫分布圖。

cues.en: So we can call df loan amount here.
cues.zh: 這裡使用 df 的 loan_amnt。

cues.en: And since I just want the actual histogram, I'll say kde is equal to false.
cues.zh: 因為只想要直方圖，設定 kde=False。

cues.en: And if you just run that, that basically gives you the basics of the histogram.
cues.zh: 直接執行，就會得到基本的直方圖。

cues.en: Then you can begin playing around with things like the bins.
cues.zh: 再開始調整 bins 等設定。

cues.en: So if you wanted more bins, you can increase the number of bins there.
cues.zh: 如果想要更多區間，就增加 bins 的數量。

cues.en: And you can also play around with things like size.
cues.zh: 也可以調整大小。

cues.en: So you can always say plt figure fig size is equal to sum tuple.
cues.zh: 使用 plt.figure，將 figsize 設成某個 tuple。

cues.en: So usually for histograms you want them long but a little shorter, so you get something that looks like this.
cues.zh: 直方圖通常適合寬一點、矮一點，所以會長這樣。

cues.en: Okay, so lots of different ways you can do that.
cues.zh: 好，有很多方式能調整。

cues.en: But this essentially something to notice here is you see these spikes happening at these even money amounts, which kind of makes sense.
cues.zh: 這裡要注意的是，尖峰出現在整數金額附近，這滿合理的。

cues.en: So clearly these bin spikes are happening at something like an even $10,000 loan instead of a spike at some random value like 8,333.
cues.zh: 例如尖峰明顯出現在整數 10,000 美元的貸款，而不是隨機的 8,333 美元。

cues.en: So that's what these little spikes are essentially indicating, that there are certain amounts that are basically standard loans.
cues.zh: 這些小尖峰表示，某些金額基本上是常見的貸款金額。

cues.en: Okay, so let's go ahead and explore the correlation between the continuous feature variables.
cues.zh: 接著探索連續特徵變數之間的相關性。

cues.en: So we can easily do this by simply just saying df and then calculating the correlation as such.
cues.zh: 只要對 df 計算相關性即可。

cues.en: So it's just a simple method call.
cues.zh: 這只是個簡單的方法呼叫。

cues.en: We've seen this already a bunch of times throughout our lectures.
cues.zh: 課程中已經看過很多次。

cues.en: We've also seen a little bit of how we can visualize it.
cues.zh: 也稍微介紹過如何視覺化。

cues.en: So the way we can visualize it is by calling sns heat map on this particular correlation.
cues.zh: 做法是對這個相關性資料呼叫 sns.heatmap。

cues.en: And we can also say annotation is equal to true.
cues.zh: 也可以設定 annot=True。

cues.en: So we have those actual links for you in case you're interested in those.
cues.zh: 如果感興趣，我們也提供了相關連結。

cues.en: And I will go ahead and change the color mapping to be cmap, viridis,
cues.zh: 我會把 cmap 改成 viridis，

cues.en: just because for me that's always a little clearer.
cues.zh: 因為對我來說比較清楚。

cues.en: So if you run this just by itself, you'll get this kind of really shrunk down heat map.
cues.zh: 如果直接執行，會得到這種縮得很小的熱圖。

cues.en: So something you can do first off is expand on the size, say plt figure.
cues.zh: 首先可以用 plt.figure 放大尺寸。

cues.en: And this should always go before your Seaborn command, say fig size, and let's make this quite a bit larger, something like 12 by 7.
cues.zh: 這行一定要放在 seaborn 指令前面，設定 figsize，例如較大的 12 乘 7。

cues.en: You run that and it will be a lot more improved.
cues.zh: 執行後會改善很多。

cues.en: But something to note here is that, depending on your version of Matplotlib, you'll notice that the bottom and the top are actually kind of cut off here and you can check
cues.zh: 不過要注意，根據 matplotlib 版本，圖的底部與頂部可能被截掉；可以查看，

cues.en: out the links we provided for you for help with resizing.
cues.zh: 我們提供的調整尺寸連結。

cues.en: So specifically this second one, we'll actually talk about that little error and that's due to Matplotlib not playing well with Seaborn.
cues.zh: 尤其第二個會討論這個小問題，原因是 matplotlib 和 seaborn 的搭配出了狀況。

cues.en: So the way you can edit that is by messing around with the Y limits.
cues.zh: 可以調整 Y 軸範圍來解決。

cues.en: So there's lots of different solutions.
cues.zh: 有很多解法。

cues.en: So one way, and we show this in the solutions notebook ourselves, is after you do the Seaborn call, simply say plt ylim and they say go from 10 to zero or something like that.
cues.zh: 其中一種，我們也在解答筆記本示範過，就是在 seaborn 指令之後呼叫 plt.ylim，例如從 10 到零。

cues.en: And that will stretch out the actual heat map.
cues.zh: 這樣就能把熱圖完整展開。

cues.en: Okay, so that's our heat map.
cues.zh: 好，這就是熱圖。

cues.en: We can see the various relationships between the features and obviously you would get a perfect correlation along the diagonal.
cues.zh: 可以看到各特徵的關係，對角線上當然都是完全相關。

cues.en: So moving along here we're gonna see is you should have noticed almost perfect correlation with this installment feature.
cues.zh: 接著，你應該有注意到 installment 特徵幾乎有完美相關。

cues.en: So if we come back up here notice that the loan amount has a 0.95 correlation with this installment.
cues.zh: 回到上面，loan_amnt 和 installment 的相關係數是 0.95。

cues.en: So that's quite interesting.
cues.zh: 這很有意思。

cues.en: So let's explore this feature further.
cues.zh: 進一步探索這個特徵。

cues.en: We wanna make sure that we're not accidentally leaking data from our features into our label.
cues.zh: 必須確認沒有不小心從特徵洩漏標籤資訊。

cues.en: So we always wanna make sure that there's not a single feature that is a perfect predictor of the label because that basically indicates that it's not really a feature, it's probably just some duplicate information
cues.zh: 要確認沒有單一特徵能完美預測標籤，因為這基本上表示它可能不是真的特徵，而只是重複資訊，

cues.en: that's very similar to the label.
cues.zh: 和標籤非常相似。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and print that out.
cues.zh: 先印出說明。

cues.en: We'll say feature information on that installment.
cues.zh: 對 installment 呼叫 feat_info。

cues.en: So we go ahead and run this and the installment is the monthly payment owed by the borrower if the loan originates.
cues.zh: 執行後可知，installment 是貸款成立時，借款人每月應付的金額。

cues.en: So keyword being if and then we'll also say feature info on the loan amount.
cues.zh: 關鍵是「如果」貸款成立；再查看 loan_amnt 的特徵資訊。

cues.en: And this is the listed amount of the loan applied for by the borrower.
cues.zh: 它是借款人申請貸款時列出的金額。

cues.en: So it pretty much makes sense that the installment and the actual loan amount would be extremely correlated because they're essentially correlated by some sort of internal formula
cues.zh: 所以每月分期金額和貸款總額高度相關，很合理，因為兩者基本上透過公司內部，

cues.en: that this company uses which kinda makes sense.
cues.zh: 某種公式連結，這是合理的。

cues.en: If you loan someone out $1 million, you would expect that following some formula your payments, your monthly payment installments are gonna be quite high.
cues.zh: 借出 100 萬美元時，可以預期依據某個公式，每月分期還款金額也會很高。

cues.en: And you'll probably use that same formula even if you loan someone a thousand dollars.
cues.zh: 就算只借出 1000 美元，大概也會用相同公式。

cues.en: And then those payments will be likely correlated to be much less.
cues.zh: 對應的還款金額就會低很多。

cues.en: So they're clearly using some sort of formula that is just a direct function of the loan amount to figure out what the installment should be.
cues.zh: 所以顯然有某種公式，直接依貸款金額算出分期付款金額。

cues.en: And we can always just do a scatter plot to confirm this.
cues.zh: 也能用散佈圖確認。

cues.en: We can say sns scatter plot and we can view this high correlation.
cues.zh: 使用 sns.scatterplot，查看高度相關的關係。

cues.en: So we see X installment, Y is equal to loan amount
cues.zh: X 設成 installment，Y 設成 loan_amnt，

cues.en: and then data is equal to df.
cues.zh: data=df。

cues.en: So we run that and we'll be able to see these actual scatter plots and you can do things like turn off the marker edge, make alpha a little lighter, et cetera.
cues.zh: 執行後就能看到散佈圖，也可以關閉標記邊框、降低 alpha 等等。

cues.en: Okay, so next we wanna create a box plot showing the relationship between the loan status and the loan amount.
cues.zh: 接著建立箱形圖，顯示 loan_status 和 loan_amnt 的關係。

cues.en: So this is going to answer the question, is there a relationship between maybe really expensive loans and not being able to pay them off or very low amount loans
cues.zh: 這要回答的是，是否有這樣的關係：金額很高的貸款比較難償還，或金額很低的貸款，

cues.en: and then fully paying those off.
cues.zh: 比較容易全額還清。

cues.en: So what we do is we simply say get a box plot
cues.zh: 做法很簡單，畫箱形圖，

cues.en: on our loan status as the X axis and then the Y axis will be our loan amount.
cues.zh: X 軸是 loan_status，Y 軸是 loan_amnt。

cues.en: And our data still remains that data frame.
cues.zh: 資料仍然使用那個資料框。

cues.en: So this allows us to explore the relationship.
cues.zh: 這樣就能探索兩者關係。

cues.en: And in general, it looks like they're pretty similar, charged off loans on average you can see this box plot is slightly higher,
cues.zh: 整體而言，看起來很相似；Charged Off 的貸款平均來說，箱形圖稍高，

cues.en: meaning that if our loan amount is higher, we have a slight increase in the likelihood of it being charged off which again intuitively makes sense that it's harder
cues.zh: 表示貸款金額較高時，成為呆帳的可能性略微增加；直覺上也合理，因為，

cues.en: to pay back larger loans than it is smaller loans.
cues.zh: 大額貸款比小額貸款更難償還。

cues.en: So they're extremely similar here.
cues.zh: 不過兩者這裡非常相似。

cues.en: So this isn't a key indicator of whether or not someone's going to pay off their loan, the actual amount they take off.
cues.zh: 因此借款金額不是能否還清貸款的關鍵指標。

cues.en: But there is a slight relationship there that we can see from this box plot.
cues.zh: 但從箱形圖仍可看到一點關係。

cues.en: And we can do this by just calculating summary statistics for the loan amount grouped by the loan status.
cues.zh: 也可以依貸款狀態分組，計算貸款金額的摘要統計。

cues.en: So I can say the following, I'll say df group by loan status.
cues.zh: 使用 df.groupby，傳入 loan_status。

cues.en: And then if I just group by loan status and then ask for describe it will show me this for all the columns.
cues.zh: 如果只依 loan_status 分組再呼叫 describe，會顯示所有欄的統計。

cues.en: So notice here there's kind of a really large data frame when really all I'm interested in in this particular case since this is what the question's asking for is the loan amount.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡的資料框很大，但這題實際關心的只是貸款金額。

cues.en: And this essentially shows us the quantitative numbers behind this box plot.
cues.zh: 這基本上顯示了箱形圖背後的實際數字。

cues.en: So if you ever get a case like this that the box plot is a little hard to read, you can always compare the averages here.
cues.zh: 如果箱形圖不容易讀，可以比較這裡的平均值。

cues.en: So you can see the charged off average price is a little higher than the fully paid loan, okay?
cues.zh: 可以看到，呆帳貸款的平均金額略高於全額清償的貸款。

cues.en: So again, all this is indicating is the averages of the loans for people that aren't able to pay them back are slightly higher than the averages for people that do pay off their loans.
cues.zh: 所以它只是表示，無法還款的人，平均貸款金額略高於會還清貸款的人。

cues.en: That's what's indicated of the box plot.
cues.zh: 箱形圖呈現的就是這點。

cues.en: And if it's a little hard to read, you can always just manually check this out.
cues.zh: 如果不容易讀，也可以手動查看數字。

cues.en: So that's what these tasks are trying to get you to realize.
cues.zh: 這就是這些任務想讓你發現的事。

cues.en: Next, let's go ahead and explore the grade and sub-grade columns that LendingClub attributes to the loans.
cues.zh: 接著探索 LendingClub 指派給貸款的 grade 和 sub_grade 欄。

cues.en: And then the first question is, what are the unique possible grades and subgrades?
cues.zh: 第一題是，可能有哪些不同的等級和子等級？

cues.en: This should be pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 這應該很直接。

cues.en: You can just simply grab the grade column and then ask for unique off of this.
cues.zh: 取得 grade 欄，再呼叫 unique。

cues.en: And you should be able to do the same thing for the subgrade column, simply say unique.
cues.zh: sub_grade 欄也可以一樣做，呼叫 unique。

cues.en: And we can see right away that the subgrades basically contain the information of the actual grade itself because it contains the letter grade and then some sort of sub character.
cues.zh: 立刻就能看出，子等級已包含等級本身的資訊，因為它有字母等級，再加上一個子分類字元。

cues.en: And if we ever wanted information on what it represents we can always say fee info and then pass in something like subgrade and it'll report back the LendingClub assigned loan subgrade.
cues.zh: 如果想知道它代表什麼，可以呼叫 feat_info，傳入 sub_grade，就會顯示 LendingClub 指派的貸款子等級。

cues.en: Okay, so we scroll down here and we wanna create a count plot per grade and set the hue to the loan status label.
cues.zh: 往下，我們要依等級畫計數圖，把 hue 設成 loan_status 標籤。

cues.en: And this way we can see if there's differentiation between fully paying off your loan or having it be charged off based off your grade.
cues.zh: 這樣能看出不同等級，全額清償與呆帳之間是否有差異。

cues.en: So we'll say sns count plot, we'll say X is equal to grade,
cues.zh: 使用 sns.countplot，設定 x=grade，

cues.en: data is our data frame and here the hue we'll go ahead and have it be our loan status.
cues.zh: data 是資料框，hue 使用 loan_status。

cues.en: We run that and here we can see the kind of a clear relationship.
cues.zh: 執行後，這裡可以看到相當清楚的關係。

cues.en: But what's a little hard to tell here is the ordering of the actual grades.
cues.zh: 但實際等級的順序不太容易看。

cues.en: So notice that we're starting with B and then going A, C, E, D, F, G.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡從 B 開始，再到 A、C、E、D、F、G。

cues.en: So what would be nice and what we're gonna do in the next problem or next task is actually show you or have you figure out how to reorder these X axes ticks.
cues.zh: 所以下一題或下一個任務，會示範或要求你想辦法重新排列 X 軸刻度。

cues.en: But essentially what this is showing is the percentage of charged off loans looks like it's increasing as the letter grade gets higher.
cues.zh: 基本上，這張圖顯示，隨著字母往後，呆帳貸款比例似乎增加。

cues.en: So it looks like the best customers are given a grade of A, the second best given a grade of B, C, D, et cetera.
cues.zh: 看起來最佳客戶是 A 等，次佳是 B，再來 C、D 等。

cues.en: And we can do this by actually comparing the ratios here.
cues.zh: 可以比較這些比例。

cues.en: So let's take a further look at this.
cues.zh: 再進一步看。

cues.en: Let's actually do it by subgrade.
cues.zh: 這次使用子等級。

cues.en: So we may need to actually resize to try to get this plot but what I'm gonna first do is get a count plot of these subgrades to see this distribution throughout the entire dataset.
cues.zh: 可能需要調整尺寸才能得到這張圖，但首先我會畫子等級的計數圖，查看整份資料的分布。

cues.en: How many A1s do we have, how many A2s do we have, et cetera.
cues.zh: 有多少 A1、多少 A2 等等。

cues.en: And we can see from the answer it looks like the majorities are A, Bs and Cs, which kinda makes sense because these are clearly the riskier loans because they're more likely to be charged off
cues.zh: 從解答可以看到，多數是 A、B、C；這很合理，因為這些顯然是較高風險的貸款，更容易成為呆帳，

cues.en: based off what we've seen here on the overall grades.
cues.zh: 這是根據剛才看到的整體等級關係。

cues.en: Notice that the fully paid versus charged off rates almost look the same for someone in the G grade category.
cues.zh: 注意，G 等級中，全額清償和呆帳的比率幾乎一樣。

cues.en: So how do we actually show this count plot per subgrade?
cues.zh: 要怎麼畫出各個子等級的計數圖？

cues.en: Well, we simply say sns dot count plot and then we'll say X is equal to subgrade,
cues.zh: 直接用 sns.countplot，設定 x=sub_grade，

cues.en: recall there's an underscore there and then our data is equal to df.
cues.zh: 記得中間有底線，data=df。

cues.en: Now if you just run this plot, you'll get something that looks like this.
cues.zh: 如果直接執行，圖會像這樣。

cues.en: So the first thing we need to fix is the size of this plot.
cues.zh: 第一件要修正的是尺寸。

cues.en: So we'll do that by saying plt figure fig size is equal to and let's go ahead and make this 12 by four.
cues.zh: 使用 plt.figure，把 figsize 設成 12 乘 4。

cues.en: Okay, so that takes care of the sizing.
cues.zh: 好，尺寸處理好了。
